whyMatters.en: Las Vegas four whose Hot Fuss (2004) stacked synth hooks, delayed guitar, and Brandon Flowers’s baritone into post-Strokes new-wave revival—Mr. Brightside became permanent alt-radio infrastructure.
whyMatters.zh: 拉斯维加斯四人组：Hot Fuss（2004）堆叠合成器钩子、延时吉他与 Brandon Flowers 男中音，构成后 Strokes 新浪潮复兴——Mr. Brightside 成为永久 alt 电台基础设施。

shortBio.en: Brandon Flowers Las Vegas new-wave revival; Mr. Brightside the durable alt single, Hot Fuss the synth-guitar template.
shortBio.zh: Brandon Flowers 拉斯维加斯新浪潮复兴；Mr. Brightside 是长寿 alt 单曲，Hot Fuss 是合成器—吉他模板。

body.en:
Formed 2001 in Las Vegas. Hot Fuss (2004) established Flowers’s baritone, Dave Keuning’s delayed guitar, synth leads, and anthemic choruses aimed at arenas from the start. Alan Moulder/Flood mixes kept brightness on radio.

Sam's Town (2006) shifted toward heartland rock scale—When You Were Young. Mr. Brightside (2003) remains the permanent chart object, re-entering UK Top 40 annually.
body.zh:
2001 年于拉斯维加斯组建。Hot Fuss（2004）确立 Flowers 男中音、Dave Keuning 延时吉他、合成器主音与从一开始就瞄准体育场的副歌。Alan Moulder/Flood 混音保持电台亮度。

Sam's Town（2006）转向 heartland rock 体量——When You Were Young。Mr. Brightside（2003）仍是永久榜单对象，年年重进英国 Top 40。

note.en: Keuning delayed arpeggios, Flowers jealousy lyric; endless UK/US rechart.
note.zh: Keuning 延时琶音、Flowers 嫉妒歌词；英美 endless 再上榜。

note.en: Hot Fuss single; staccato synth bass hook, dance-floor tempo.
note.zh: Hot Fuss 单曲；断奏合成器贝斯钩子、舞池 tempo。

note.en: Sam's Town lead; Springsteen-scale chorus, arena ambition stated.
note.zh: Sam's Town 主打；Springsteen 体量副歌，明确体育场野心。

title.zh: 新浪潮复兴到体育场设计

body.en:
Hot Fuss borrows 1980s synth/new-wave hooks without garage rawness—Somebody Told Me’s staccato bass, Mr. Brightside’s delayed guitar loop. Flowers writes jealousy narratives at dance tempo.

Sam's Town states Springsteen-scale chorus ambition explicitly.
body.zh:
Hot Fuss 借用 1980 年代合成器/新浪潮钩子，无车库毛边——Somebody Told Me 的断奏贝斯、Mr. Brightside 的延时吉他循环。Flowers 在 dance tempo 写嫉妒叙事。

Sam's Town 明确声明 Springsteen 体量副歌野心。

title.en: Classic four from Hot Fuss onward
title.zh: Hot Fuss 起的经典四人组

body.en:
Flowers/Keuning founding pair; Stoermer and Vannucci join 2002 for the Hot Fuss sessions. Stoermer hiatus 2016–2020; core trio recorded Wonderful Wonderful.

Live silhouette stays four-piece rock with synth triggers.
body.zh:
Flowers/Keuning 创始双人；Stoermer 与 Vannucci 2002 年加入 Hot Fuss 录音。Stoermer 2016–2020  hiatus；核心三人组录 Wonderful Wonderful。

现场剪影仍是带合成器触发的四人摇滚。

title.zh: Mr. Brightside 作为 alt 电台基础设施

body.en:
Post-Strokes indie boom needed a Vegas stadium counterweight—synth plus guitar, not Brooklyn lo-fi. Mr. Brightside’s endless rechart proves hook durability over trend cycles.

Interpol’s dark new-wave and Killers’ bright new-wave share 2000s revival timing.
body.zh:
后 Strokes indie 热潮需要拉斯维加斯体育场配重——合成器加吉他，非布鲁克林 lo-fi。Mr. Brightside 无尽再上榜证明钩子耐久超过潮流周期。

Interpol 的暗新浪潮与 Killers 的亮新浪潮共享 2000 年代复兴时机。
